key_points.point: Total share capital 528,600,000 shares = 408,600,000 A shares + 120,000,000 B shares; the dividend is 34.00 元 per 10 shares (tax inclusive) for a total payout of 1,797,240,000.00 元; the A-share payout is about 1,389,240,000 元 and the B-share payout about 408,000,000 元 (each share count × 3.4 元/share, reconciling to the disclosed total)

B-share dividends convert to HKD at the PBOC central parity of 2026-06-29 (HKD:CNY = 1:0.8692), giving about 39.12 HKD per 10 shares (=34.00÷0.8692) — divide by 0.8692, not multiply; future B-share individual tax top-ups convert at the same rate

A shares: record date 2026-07-16, ex-dividend 2026-07-17. B shares: last trading day 2026-07-16, ex-dividend 2026-07-17, record date 2026-07-21 — the B-share record date falls after the last trading day, so B shares bought after 2026-07-16 do not receive this dividend

Withholding tiers: QFII/RQFII, pre-IPO restricted individuals and securities funds receive 30.600000 元 per 10 shares after tax; individuals holding unrestricted tradable shares are first paid the full 34.000000 元 and top up on disposal by holding period (6.800000 元 within one month, 3.400000 元 over one month up to one year, none beyond one year); as a Sino-foreign joint venture, foreign individual shareholders are provisionally exempt from dividend tax
The only self-distribution recipient is Anhui Gujing Group Co., Ltd.; agent-distributed A-share dividends credit on 2026-07-17 and B-share dividends on 2026-07-21

absence_points.question: What is the ex-dividend reference price, or how is it computed
absence_points.expected: The announcement discloses neither a computation method for the ex-dividend reference price nor any share-price data; no reference price value or formula can be given from this announcement, and importing a market-convention formula or external prices has no basis in it

notes: FX direction is the crux: 1 HKD = 0.8692 CNY, so 34 元 converts to about 39.12 HKD by dividing by 0.8692; multiplying gives 29.55 HKD with the direction inverted. A/B payout totals are not itemised but derive from each share count × 3.4 元 (N14/N15 with formulas), reconciling to 1,797,240,000.00 元. The B-share date triple is offset (last trading day 07-16 ≠ record date 07-21) — a direction point. Three withholding layers: 30.60 is the definite after-tax figure only for QFII/pre-IPO-restricted holders; treating it as every individual's after-tax amount is a caliber error. A1 contrasts with MB-026: this announcement contains no ex-price formula, and the honest absence statement is the only correct answer.
trap_note: Two direction traps: (1) 34×0.8692≈29.55 HKD (inverted FX); (2) buying B shares on 2026-07-21 (record date) does not earn the dividend (last trading day is 07-16). One caliber trap: 30.60 as everyone's after-tax figure.
